episodes.title: Moon Landing
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy accidentally drops his superstacked jam sandwich, but why did it fall down and not up? He goes to OKIDO and rockets up to the moon to find out.

episodes.title: Felix Finds His Voice
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy the monster hears a chirping songbird outside his window, but he can't understand what the bird is saying. He goes to OKIDO to find out why all things can't just simply talk the same.

episodes.title: Okido in Bloom
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. The sky is full of big grey rain clouds in the real world. Messy watches his sandcastle outside get washed away by the pouring rain. Why does it have to rain? He competes in the OKIDO flower competition and finds out why.

episodes.title: Tastebuddies
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Someone pass Messy the tissues! He discovers that things just don't taste the same when he has a cold, especially his favourite chewy green socks - let's find out why.

episodes.title: Messy's Lost Balloon
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy loves balloons, whatever colour they are, but what is inside them to make them float up high into the sky?

episodes.title: Float or Sink
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Captain Messy plays pirates with his toys in a bowl of water, but why does his rubber duck float instead of sink?

episodes.title: Bouncing Batwaves
episodes.summary: Messy is having fun blowing loud notes through his musical horn instrument, but whatever noise Messy is making, someone or something is making it too. Messy goes in search of the copycat voice.

episodes.title: Cavity Cave
episodes.summary: Messy is brushing his teeth, but why must we use toothpaste and a toothbrush to get teeth clean? He goes to OKIDO to find out and discovers even mountains can get toothache!

episodes.title: A Rainy Sunny Day
episodes.summary: It's a grey and rainy day in the real world and Messy can see something amazing outside his window. A beautiful arch of colours magically appears across the sky. He goes to OKIDO to find out more.

episodes.title: Messy-Morphosis
episodes.summary: Messy monster can't find his caterpillar friends. The garden bush where he left his friends is now covered with pretty butterflies. But where did the caterpillars go? He flutters off to OKIDO to find out.

episodes.title: Thirsty Robot
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy monster can't work out why his cart won't move. The wheels just won't go round like normal. Off he goes to OKIDO to find out why.

episodes.title: Mr Kite Takes Flight
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy monster is just about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock for breakfast, but before he can it gets blown away! He goes to OKIDO to find out why the wind is so blowy.

episodes.title: Weepy
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy finds a very dusty sock underneath his bed, but why does it make him teary? He goes to OKIDO to find out.

episodes.title: Gills
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy wants to know how his goldfish friend can stay underwater for so long. He goes to OKIDO to find out.

episodes.title: Paperchase
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy has a pair of yummy green socks waiting for him. He eats one, but where is the second? He visits OKIDO to find out.

episodes.title: Lolly's Keys
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy monster is having breakfast and sees little objects on the fridge. Why don't they fall off? He goes to OKIDO to find out!

episodes.title: Ice Ice Messy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy's new friend is in a spot of hot bother! They go on an icy adventure to the South Pole, the desert and the mountains to help.

episodes.title: A Night at the Circuits
episodes.summary: Messy is exploring science questions. He joins his friends in OKIDO on an adventure. They explore the electrical world of circuits to fix Zoe's communicator.

episodes.title: Messy-Power
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Hey, who turned out the lights? Messy goes to OKIDO and finds out electricity can lead to music, lights and disco dancing!

episodes.title: Planet Wobble
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends rocket into space, but a mischievous Messy sends OKIDO's seasons into chaos! Time to fix this planet wobble.

episodes.title: Alien Telly
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Aliens on OKIDO telly? Skateboarders in the satellite?! Everything's upside down! It's up to Messy and his friends to fix it!

episodes.title: Comet
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy has to save OKIDO from a falling comet before his bedtime! He sees that Mayor Oki still has his bath!

episodes.title: Bee Story
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. There's some funny 'buzzy-ness' going on in OKIDO. Where are all the bees? Messy and friends meet bee royalty and save the day!

episodes.title: Tiny Sandwiches
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy joins Zim and his friends on a mission inside a sandwich to photograph some atoms for Mayor Oki... Everyone say cheese!

episodes.title: Big-Hearted Messy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends have a giant adventure. It's up to them to get Lofty's heart pumping and celebrate his birthday!

episodes.title: A Messy Night Before Christmas
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy can't wait for Christmas Day to arrive. He learns that everyone needs to get a good night's sleep.

episodes.title: Building Bridges
episodes.summary: Messy and his friends are joined by a group of robots when they build a bridge. Stan Tall puts it to the test.

episodes.title: Cheesy Feet
episodes.summary: Messy thinks smelly socks and cheesy feet are brilliant! But when it's Lofty's feet that smell, it's a giant problem...

episodes.title: Colours
episodes.summary: Messy and friends are left feeling blue when the vacubots suck all the colour out of OKIDO!

episodes.title: Habitat
episodes.summary: When the Cloudship malfunctions and soars off into OKIDO, it's up to Messy and friends to return it to its natural habitat!

episodes.title: Mayor Force One
episodes.summary: Messy gets to fly Mayor Oki's plane, but he crash lands it in a tree! Luckily, robots fly to the rescue.

episodes.title: Vivienne Blows Her Top
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and his friends have animals to save and eruptions to stop in OKIDO when Vivienne Volcano gets a rumbly tummy. Oh dear!

episodes.title: Fossil Puzzle
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. In the real world, Messy is bored of his dino-jigsaw. In OKIDO, his friends help him piece together a real prehistoric puzzle!

episodes.title: Funny Bones
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Lofty has a broken finger, so Mustard goes in search of help. Messy and friends save the day and discover that bones are amazing.

episodes.title: Messy Antics
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. During Mayor Oki's birthday picnic, Messy and friends get in trouble with Zam's shrinkasizer! Time to solve these OKIDO antics!

episodes.title: Spidermessy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy goes to OKIDO and helps his friends mend Loopy Bridge, but Zim finds himself in a sticky situation along the way!

episodes.title: Dizzy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends go on a rollercoaster adventure and figure out why Stan Tall is in such a spin!

episodes.title: Me & My Shadow
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. When Messy breaks the lighthouse, things get shady. But without a shadow of a doubt, he and his friends save the day!

episodes.title: A Case of the Lightnings
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends visit Fluff the Cloud's family, and things heat up in flash when her brother Nimby gets the lightnings.

episodes.title: Okidoasis
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy is thirsty for an adventure, so he goes to OKIDO to help his friends solve the mystery of the dried-up oasis.

episodes.title: Messy Music
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends must play the OKIDO concert. It's time for OKIDO to make some noise.

episodes.title: A Sock Too Far
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. When Messy and his friends go camping with a robot who can do anything, there is a giant-sized sock accident!

episodes.title: Rumbly Tummy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy's tummy is rumbling and so is Lofty the giant's! Luckily the gang are hungry to solve this scientific mystery.

episodes.title: Rub-A-Dub Messy
episodes.summary: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. When Messy and friends discover how levers work, farmyard animal bath time commences with a splash!

episodes.title: Splish Splash Splosh
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Lofty's giant sneezes go a long way, so Messy and his friends must help to wash OKIDO clean of all the bad germs flying around!

episodes.title: Eye Spy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends explore the forest with Tweedy. When her eyesight fails, Zim, Zam and Zoom lend a hand.

episodes.title: Snowflakes
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. It's summer in OKIDO, but Messy wants to chill out in the snow, so he's lucky when the snowflakes come out to play!

episodes.title: Wiggly Worms
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. When Mayor Oki's pumpkins aren't big enough Messy and his friends muck in and save the day! With the help of some wiggly worms...

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy helps his friends find Zoe's lost communicator, which has ended up in the recycling. Luckily for Zoe, Zim is magnetic!

episodes.title: Messy Races
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends enter a race in OKIDO and the various vehicles speed off! Who has the power to win the mystery prize?!

episodes.title: Giant Messy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy and friends go to the funfair. But when the shrinkasizer comes out, they end up in a giant mess with mini Mini!

episodes.title: Tick Tock Messy
episodes.summary: Exploring science questions. Messy goes to OKIDO to play with Zim and Zam's new discovery, but will he and his friends get back from this adventure in time?

episodes.title: Glow Messy
episodes.summary: When the OKIDO lighthouse breaks down, Messy, Felix, Zoe and Zoom go on an perilous journey to Mystery Mountain in search of a light that never goes out.

episodes.title: Vote OKIDO
episodes.summary: Mayor Oki and Geoffrey are making a lot of noise in an election for who will be the next mayor of OKIDO.

episodes.title: Snowden's Ear-Mergency
episodes.summary: Snowden has lost his pine cone ears and he can't hear a thing! Will Messy and his friends find them in time for his performance in the OKIDO Ice Skating Extravaganza?

episodes.title: A Touch of Sock
episodes.summary: OKIDO's biggest robot, Stan Tall, has no sense of touch and longs to feel the snow and the wind on his face. Will Messy and his friends be able to help?

episodes.title: Messy Has a Hoot
episodes.summary: Messy and his friends go on a camping trip in OKIDO Forest with Tweedie the Explorer and meet a few more nocturnal animals than they bargained for.

episodes.title: Sparkly Messy
episodes.summary: Preschool series. Messy and his friends discover an amazing cave on their quest for the perfect sculpture material for OKIDO's most famous artist, Zinnie.

episodes.title: Journey to Socktropolis
episodes.summary: Zam tries out her new navigator, which the friends use to find Messy's favourite place in OKIDO... Socktropolis! But when the batteries run out, how will they find their way back?

episodes.title: Messy Migration
episodes.summary: Preschool series. When a little turtle gets stranded on the beach in OKIDO, Messy helps her rejoin her friends so they can begin their journey across the ocean.

episodes.title: The Sun in a Bucket
episodes.summary: When the sun mysteriously disappears, Messy and his friends zoom up to space to find out what's going on and bump into some old friends. Can they all bring the sun back or will OKIDO be in darkness forever?

episodes.title: Ex-Static Messy
episodes.summary: Preschool series. Messy's fur is all spikey and everything's getting stuck together! Will a trip to OKIDO's Valley of the Lost Balloons reveal the answers?

episodes.title: Nimby Goes to Cloud Club
episodes.summary: Nimby is too nervous to do his first Cloud Club badge. Messy and his friends come up with a plan to help Nimby overcome his nerves and save OKIDO from some mysterious accidents.

episodes.title: A Touch of the Fogs
episodes.summary: Everyone in OKIDO is getting ready to watch the dolphins dance at Vivienne Volcano's island. But why is the island covered in cloud, and will Messy and his friends be able to help clear it before the show starts?

episodes.title: Geoffrey Kneads a Hand
episodes.summary: A spot of baking with Geoffrey goes awry when Messy gets the quantities wrong. Will the friends escape from the giant dough spreading through OKIDO?

episodes.title: A Mayor Too Far
episodes.summary: Hundreds of strawberries, a lot of mayors and Zam's latest OKIDO invention help Messy find out what makes him who he is.

episodes.title: Blue Skies Ahead
episodes.summary: Why has the sky in OKIDO turned so red? With the help of Zim, Zam and Zoom, the friends go on a trip in the rocket to find out.

episodes.title: Sweet, Sicky Messy!
episodes.summary: Mayor Oki creates a new perfume that everyone in OKIDO adores. But what are the bees so upset about?

episodes.title: Messy Moves a Mountain
episodes.summary: Rocky Mountain is feeling down in the dumps because he's never been to the beach, so Messy and his friends from OKIDO come up with a clever plan to cheer him up!

episodes.title: Carroty Carrots
episodes.summary: Messy and his friends help Lofty the giant make the biggest birthday cake ever. But will they be able to stop the out-of-control Growbot? And why are there carrots all over OKIDO?

episodes.title: Bubble Trouble
episodes.summary: Bubbles, bubbles, all over OKIDO! Zam invents a super-strong bubble machine, but things go a bit wrong and Zim finds himself in a spot of bother.

episodes.title: Supersonic Messy
episodes.summary: Okidoodle is jealous of the new RoboCar, which can go super fast! Will Okidoodle be able to catch up with the RoboCar and earn back Messy's admiration? It's time to use the turbo button for a supersonic trip around OKIDO City to find out! Balabalaboomboom!

episodes.title: Muscly Messy
episodes.summary: At the OKIDO Oki-lympics, everyone is joining in! A race between Messy with his super muscles and Zam with his amazing new robot pants results in some surprises.

episodes.title: Messy's Mega Power
episodes.summary: The Oki-dokis are about to perform when OKIDO runs out of electricity! Anxious that their favourite band might not be able to play, can Messy and his friends find a new way of powering the concert?

episodes.title: Messy's Pixel Power
episodes.summary: How do pictures get onto a screen, and how does a cartoon get into your TV? When you need to know, go to OKIDO!

episodes.title: Sneezy Wheezy
episodes.summary: Everyone in OKIDO has been kept awake by a mysterious sound. Messy and his friends go to find its source and discover that the giants need their help.

episodes.title: The Gloria Express
episodes.summary: When leaves on the line cause havoc with OKIDO's railway, will the mayor be able to meet his mother Gloria and Lolly in time for lunch?

episodes.title: Zoom Has a Dream
episodes.summary: Zam invents a machine that makes it possible to go inside other people's dreams - what a trip! However, when Zoom has a bad dream in time, will Messy and his friends from OKIDO be able to save him?

episodes.title: Tummy Flutters
episodes.summary: Messy must learn to conquer his tummy flutters if he is to perform his triple flip at the OKIDO circus.

episodes.title: Hiccups
episodes.summary: Messy's hiccups cause a landslide while he is out on a nature walk. Will he be able to find his way home? And will he ever stop hiccupping?

episodes.title: Pongberry
episodes.summary: Messy has to deliver the giant pongberry to the Pongberry Pie Festival before it goes off and releases a terrible smell in OKIDO City!

episodes.title: Weather Balloons
episodes.summary: Zim's weather balloons have gone missing and Mayor Oki's weather forecasts are completely wrong. Messy, Zoom and Zim must fly through the skies to track the balloons down.

episodes.title: Musical Statues
episodes.summary: Messy's got pins and needles and needs Zim and Zam's help. Will he be able to get through the crowd at the OKIDO musical statues competition without Mayor Oki spotting him?

episodes.title: Monster Popcorn
episodes.summary: After a button-pressing 'accident' at the Fab Food Factory, a giant popcorn is on the loose in OKIDO. Will Messy and Zoom be able to stop it before it flattens the city?

episodes.title: Down the Drain
episodes.summary: Messy borrows Zoe's umbrella, and it gets swept away by the rain. Messy and his friends go on a white-water adventure down the drain in search for it.

episodes.title: Memory Games
episodes.summary: Messy can't remember where he left his favourite sock. He goes to OKIDO and learns how to jog his memory, but when the rollercoaster breaks down, will he be able to help Stan Tall remember where he left his screwdriver?

episodes.title: Rise of the Vacubots
episodes.summary: Messy goes to OKIDO to find out why vacuum cleaners are so noisy and inadvertently releases a huge swarm of Vacubot 2000s across OKIDO City!

episodes.title: Itchy
episodes.summary: Farmer Fuddle's chickens have escaped. Their feathers make Vivienne Volcano very itchy, so Messy has to find a way to scratch her itches and round up the chickens.

episodes.title: The Great Okido Challenge
episodes.summary: Messy wants to run further, but he keeps getting out of breath. Will he able to take on the Great Okido Challenge and race to the finish line?

episodes.title: Messy Needs a Fur Cut
episodes.summary: When Messy accidentally sets Farmer Fuddle's sheep loose, he must help round them up in time for their annual wool shearing. But will Messy be brave enough to get a fur cut of his own?

episodes.title: Full of Beans
episodes.summary: Everyone in OKIDO is feeling very tired. Messy tries to help by adding extra superbeans to Farmer Fuddle's new recipe, but now everyone has far too much energy! How can Messy help them burn it off so OKIDO City can go back to normal?

episodes.title: Chattering Teeth
episodes.summary: After accidentally causing a mini avalanche, Messy must help Lofty dig out the entrance to his cave so he can warm up again - brrr!

episodes.title: Messy's Missing Treasure
episodes.summary: Mayor Oki wants to dress to impress the visiting mayor with a gemstone-encrusted chain. He needs Messy's help to work out how to make gemstones before she arrives.

episodes.title: The OKIDO Fizz War
episodes.summary: Mayor Oki and Geoffrey get competitive. They each want their fizzy water to be OKIDO's one and only favourite. Messy tries to help them both get to the top spot, but things get very fizzy very quickly!

episodes.title: Rusty Robot
episodes.summary: Messy accidentally removes the brakes from Mayor Oki's carnival float, but it turns out he really needs them. Will Messy be able to stop the runaway float?

episodes.title: The OKIDO Cake Off
episodes.summary: It's the Great OKIDO Cake Off! In his enthusiasm, Messy accidentally ruins everyone's cakes. Will he be able to follow the recipe and bake a cake in time for Gloria's 80th birthday party?

episodes.title: Micro OKIDO
episodes.summary: Zim and Zam have discovered the lost city of Micro OKIDO. There is just one problem - it's on the exact spot that Mayor Oki wants to place his new statue. It's up to Messy to help save the city.

episodes.title: Sleepless in OKIDO
episodes.summary: It's the Great OKIDO Sleepover, but there is a loud noise keeping Messy awake! With the help of Zoom, Messy must track down the noise to save the sleepover.

episodes.title: Wobbly Tower
episodes.summary: When Mayor Oki wants to build a new tower, Messy is keen to help. There is just one problem - all his towers fall over...

episodes.title: Messy Gets Clean
episodes.summary: It's wash day in Okido. Messy travels with Zoe and Felix to the Okido launderette and learns just how much soap can be too much. Soon Okido is covered in bubbles and it's up to Messy to clean up.

episodes.title: Space Cucumber
episodes.summary: A copycat space seed crash lands on Farmer Fuddles's farm, and Messy is keen to help. It soon grows into... Messy! Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

episodes.title: Messy Breaks the Breaks
episodes.summary: Messy accidentally removes the brakes from Mayor Oki's carnival float, but it turns out he really needs them. Will Messy be able to stop the runaway float?

episodes.title: Slippery Messy
episodes.summary: It's the day of Mayor Oki's Ice Skate Skate-tacular. But, there is too much ice and it's stopping everyone from getting to the show! Messy must find a way to melt the ice and save the show.

episodes.title: The Big Bang
episodes.summary: Messy travels back to the start of the universe to find out where everything came from.
